item.title: The biggest sporting events in San Diego history
item.description: San Diego has hosted a variety of major sporting events, including three Super Bowls, two World Series, two MLB All-Star Games, two NBA All-Star Games, two U.S. Open Championships, and the 2016 Major League Baseball All-Star Game, and will host Olympic soccer and surfing in 2028.

item.title: Noah Kahan's 'The Great Divide' tour hits Petco Park, San Diego
item.description: Noah Kahan, the multi-Grammy-nominated artist, will be making a stop in San Diego on his The Great Divide North American Tour.

item.title: Kaiser gives update on local union negotiations as strike enters third week
item.description: Hundreds of health care workers have joined the Kaiser nurses' strike in San Diego County as it enters its third week.

item.title: Where to find a deal on National Pizza Day in San Diego
item.description: (FOX 5/KUSI) — America's favorite food gets its own day of celebration on Feb. 9 with National Pizza Day, and several San Diego restaurants are making it easy to get in on a slice of the pie. item.title: Chula Vista's Jason Myers sets NFL record in Seahawks' Super Bowl win
item.description: While the Seahawks defense played a key role in the team's second-ever Super Bowl victory, it was the team's kicker, Jason Myers, who helped place them on the scoreboard early and set the tone for the rest of the game.

item.title: San Diego County offices closed Feb. 16 for Presidents' Day
item.description: All San Diego County offices, family resource centers, public health centers, libraries and animal shelters will be closed on Monday, Feb. 16 for the Presidents' Day holiday.

item.title: Coronado's Sandcastle Man banned from Hotel Del Coronado property
item.description: Bill Pavlacka, known as The Sandcastle Man, was told he can no longer build his sandcastles on Hotel del Coronado property after nearly 20 years, due to violating hotel policies and creating political messages.

item.title: El Cajon City Councilmember leaves Republican Party, registers as Democrat
item.description: Gary Kendrick, El Cajon City Councilmember and longtime Republican official, announced he is now registered as Democrat due to fear-driven political ideologies and community concerns regarding increased immigration enforcement.

item.title: Chula Vista police chief claims city leaders are pushing her out
item.description: Chula Vista Police Chief Roxana Kennedy is accusing city leaders of trying to force her out due to an incident at a holiday party.

item.title: Man dies after suffering medical emergency on I-5 in San Diego
item.description: A man died late last week after suffering an unspecified medical emergency on northbound Interstate 5 in San Diego, California Highway Patrol said.
